map.ETc = Kc × ETo，分生育期累计得全期需水。: ETc = Kc x ETo; accumulate it over the growth stages to get the water requirement for the whole season.
map.ETc = Kc × ET₀，其中 ET₀ 为参考蒸散量（可用彭曼公式计算），K: ETc = Kc x ET0, where ET0 is the reference evapotranspiration (computable with the Penman-Monteith equation) and Kc varies with the growth stage. Daily demand times the number of days gives the crop demand for that period; subtracting effective rainfall gives net irrigation, which is then grossed up by irrigation efficiency and converted to cubic metres by area, guiding the irrigation schedule.

map.不一定，要看降雨补给。半湿润区降雨可覆盖大半需水，真正要靠灌溉补的只是『缺口』，: Not necessarily; it depends on rainfall recharge. In semi-humid regions rainfall can cover most of the demand, and only the "gap" really needs irrigation. Irrigating the full ETc blindly would waterlog the field and waste water.
